description_for_human: Search domain availability and compare prices across 6 registrars. Get detailed domain intelligence.
description_for_model: Use this API when the user wants to: (1) find available domain names for a keyword or brand, (2) compare domain registration prices across registrars to find the cheapest, (3) check if a specific domain is available, (4) look up who owns a domain or when it expires, (5) find nameservers or RDAP/WHOIS data for a domain, (6) get an AI-powered valuation of what a domain is worth. Endpoints: GET /api/search?q={keyword} for availability + pricing across 6 registrars, GET /api/domain/{domain} for detailed RDAP/WHOIS/DNS intelligence (covers RDAP-less TLDs like .sh, .io, .ac via port-43 WHOIS), GET /api/valuate/{domain} for AI valuation. Also available as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server: `npx -y donadomains-mcp`. Prices are live-scraped, not cached.
